title: Multiple Choice (1 point each)
instructions: Select the best answer for each question.

prompts.question: What does normalizing a Vector3 do?
answers: It adjusts the x, y and z values so the magnitude is 1.
It wipes all of the x, y, and z values.
It sets the Y value to 1.
prompts.correct_answer: It adjusts the x, y and z values so the magnitude is 1.

prompts.question: What method is typically used to detect when one object makes physical contact (like a ball hitting a wall)?
What is the result of calling Instantiate(prefab)?
answers: It creates a new instance of the prefab
It unloads the prefab from memory
prompts.correct_answer: It creates a new instance of the prefab

prompts.question: What happens if you try to access a component that doesn't exist using GetComponent?
What's the difference between GetKeyDown and GetKey?
answers: GetKeyDown fires once when key is first pressed; GetKey returns true while held
GetKeyDown returns true while key is held; GetKey only fires once
prompts.correct_answer: GetKeyDown fires once when key is first pressed; GetKey returns true while held

prompts.question: Which data type is best for storing true/false values?

prompts.question: Which best describes Input.GetButton vs Input.GetKey?
answers: GetButton uses Input Manager mappings, GetKey checks physical keys
